'''Sha'je''' was a type of duel using two daggers called [[aran'gar]] and [[osan'gar]] (right-hand side dagger and left-hand side dagger) at the end of the [[Age of Legends]]. The tips of the daggers were poisoned, so often none of the participants survived.{{ref|{{twotc}},sha'je}}

==Mentions==
A particular sha'je duel at [[Qal]] was mentioned on one of Graendal's and Sammael's secret meetings.{{ref/book|6|6}}
